suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as population specific temporal risk. Apply only to bronchiolitis occurring before age 2 followed by later childhood wheeze/asthma; require separately diagnosed asthma. Pediatric early-life evidence; do not generalize to adult-onset bronchiolitis or claim causation. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Constrictive / Obliterative Bronchiolitis matches the source-specific phenotype or population
Independent diagnosis of Asthma with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors
Qualified clinical opinion before applying the population-level relationship to an individual case
